descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Fighter Pilot puts you in the seat of a modern fighter jet.

YOUR SQUADRON HANGAR
You start on the hangar floor with your ground crew around the jet. The crew chief salutes, you climb the stairs and step into the cockpit.

CANOPY DOWN
On runway 27 the canopy closes over your head as the take-off roll begins. Push the throttle past the detent for the afterburner and lift off.

A REAL COCKPIT
A wide panoramic display, a side-stick, a throttle, a gear handle and standby instruments, all live, under a clear bubble canopy.

SIX SORTIES
Quick Reaction Alert, Tanker Rendezvous, Recon Run, Coast Race, Sunset Flypast and Night Intercept. Each one is scored with stars. Pick one from the briefing board in the hangar.

EMERGENCIES
A flameout at 25,000 ft, a dead-stick glide home and a hydraulic failure, each with a checklist card in the cockpit.

FREE FLIGHT
An island with mountains, a city, a coast and real clouds, by day, at sunset or at night. Landing challenges and ring courses.

YOUR JET
Paint it your way in the paint shop and power wash it clean.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a 4-digit code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.

A flying game: no weapons and no combat.
